method: Native effective copper geometry and drill disks; read-only; no source refill/save.

live_to_isolated_nominal_copper.scope: Native copper, filled planes, pads and vias. The XY projection ignores layer depth. Measurements exclude populated component bodies, screws, wires, air paths around the board edge, material ratings, production tolerances and contamination.

limitations: Dimensions are nominal; drill/registration/material tolerances need manufacturer acceptance.
Final Gerber mask-opening merges and font clearance are checked separately.
No simulation, functional hardware, thermal, EMC or installation test is implied.
